# Getting help

1. **Run the checker first:** `python ~/.claude/skills/video-studio-core/scripts/check_env.py`. It prints the exact fix for anything missing.
2. **Read the docs:** the [README](README.md), the full [catalog](docs/catalog.md) of every skill and move, and the references in `plugins/video-studio/skills/video-studio-core/references/`.
3. **Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Viprasol-Tech/claude-video-editing-skills/discussions)** for how-to questions and to share what you made.
4. **Open an issue** for bugs and style or feature requests, using the forms.

Never attach private footage; a description or a still is enough.
